plan.title: Recreate Order with Extremely Large Price

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ as the buyer.
Open the Recreate Order window from the event's Settings menu.
Verify that the Recreate Order window opened.
Enter the extremely large price in the required Price field.
Submit the recreated order and let the application determine how it handles the value.
Capture any success, warning, or error toast produced by submitting the large price.
